# `release` operations

4 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### release.keystore

**Create signing key**

Create a new RSA-4096 PKCS12 signing identity. Existing files are never overwritten.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `password_file` | string | yes |  | Owner-only file containing one password; never stored in job arguments |
| `alias` | string | yes |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}` |
| `output` | string | yes |  |  |
| `distinguished_name` | string |  | `"CN=Tomacco Development"` | non-empty, up to 500 characters |
| `validity_days` | integer |  | `10000` | 365 to 36500 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call release.keystore '{"output":"<output>","password_file":"<password_file>","alias":"<alias>"}'
```

### release.sign

**Sign Android release**

Align APKs for 16 KiB pages, sign APK/AAB, verify signatures, then atomically publish a new artifact.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `password_file` | string | yes |  | Owner-only file containing one password; never stored in job arguments |
| `alias` | string | yes |  | matching `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,100}` |
| `keystore` | string | yes |  |  |
| `path` | string | yes |  |  |
| `output` | string | yes |  |  |
| `key_password_file` | string |  |  | Optional distinct key password; defaults to the keystore password |

```sh
tomaccoctl call release.sign '{"path":"<path>","output":"<output>","keystore":"<keystore>","password_file":"<password_file>","alias":"<alias>"}'
```

### release.version

**Set app version**

Update a literal Flutter/Android version and build number with a recoverable backup.

Annotations: **destructive**, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  |  |
| `version` | string | yes |  |  |
| `build_number` | integer | yes |  | 1 to 2100000000 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call release.version '{"path":"<path>","version":"<version>","build_number":1}'
```
